review: The current remote omits a lower button and compresses the rocker. No written feedback. Restored all four button positions and a longer volume rocker inside a rounded shell; the divider and tiny label are omitted to preserve control spacing.
references: No useful local remote match; rounded enclosure and equal button spacing from the supplied reference.
visual_review: Reviewed original, rejected drawing and fresh SVG together; inspected native 48px light and dark previews. Recognizable subject, coherent curves, uniform strokes and readable negative space.
